paragraphs: I'm applying for the Strategic Finance & FP&A Manager role in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The role appeals to me because it sits on Duolingo's monetization engine, where user and subscriber growth turns into revenue, and it puts FP&A right next to the pricing and product experiments that move it.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, running variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation, and building AI powered dashboards with financial projections for leadership. At JPMorgan Asset Management I built models to evaluate $10M in marketing-channel budget deployment and benchmarked past allocations to find 30% efficiency gains.

That maps to the forecasting, planning models and clear recommendations the team owns. I haven't worked inside a consumer subscription business yet, and I'm used to turning detailed analysis into a short story for senior people. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the role.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli applying for the Strategic Finance & FP&A Manager role at Duolingo. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and at JPMorgan Asset Management I modeled $10M in marketing-channel budget deployment. I'd love to hear how FP&A works with the monetization team. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
